info.title: WasteMates Enquiry API
info.description: Accepts quote/enquiry submissions from the WasteMates website's hero, contact, and pricing forms and dispatches them to the team via email, Telegram, and Discord. This is the form-backend for wastemates.com.au, documented here for API discovery (RFC 9727) rather than as a general-purpose third-party integration.

post.description: Accepts a form submission with the enquirer's details and optional job photos. The endpoint always responds with a 303 redirect back to the site (even on validation failure or an empty submission) — it has no JSON error responses, matching its use as a plain HTML form target.

contact_preference.description: How the enquirer prefers to be contacted, e.g. "Phone" or "Email".

job.description: Type of job, e.g. "Household rubbish removal".

photos.description: Up to 8 photos of the job. 6MB per photo, 15MB combined. Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, image/heic, image/heif.

_redirect.description: Which page to redirect back to after submission. Defaults to contact.html if omitted or unrecognized.

_source.description: Label identifying which on-site form submitted the enquiry, used in the notification subject line.

schema.description: At least one of name, mobile, or email is required — a submission with none of the three is silently dropped (still returns 303).

303.description: Submission processed (or intentionally dropped as spam/empty) and redirected back to the site.

Location.description: Relative path of the originating page with ?sent=1 appended, e.g. /contact.html?sent=1.
